The '''Tanner Ranch''' was located in the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was the home of the Tanner family, [[Jahn Tanner|Jahn]] and [[Lania Tanner|Lania]] and their son, [[Shan Tanner|Shan]]. The ranch was also the home of their three farmhands, [[Wes Hogaan|Wes]] and [[Dana Hogaan]] and their daughter, [[Minda Hogaan|Minda]].<ref name="GG1" />
